$comment: The reviewed exceptions to the 7-day release age that pnpm-workspace.yaml makes (self-host-install: Release pipeline integrity; decisions-from-groups-15-28, D55 (86)). When the image scan reports a fixable HIGH or CRITICAL finding in Node's binary or in an npm package whose fixed version is younger than 7 days, a reviewed pull request with the release-age-exception label may take exactly the version the advisory names as fixed: it adds "<package>@<version>" to minimumReleaseAgeExclude in pnpm-workspace.yaml and records the exception here, with the package, the version, the advisory, the label and the day the version turns 7 days old (agedOn), after which pnpm check:workflows fails until the exclusion and its record are removed. The list holds exactly the exceptions in force, and the release notes list them. CONTRIBUTING.md says how.
